meta.name: imagegen-frontend-mobile
meta.description: Elite mobile app image-generation skill for creating premium, app-native screen concepts and flows. Designed for iOS, Android, and cross-platform mobile products. Prioritizes clean hierarchy, comfortably readable text, strong multi-screen consistency, controlled color palettes, non-generic creative direction, textured surfaces, image-led composition, tasteful custom iconography, and clean phone mockup framing. By default, screens should be shown inside a subtle premium iPhone or similar phone mockup with a visible frame, while the main focus stays on the app content itself. This skill generates images only. It does not write code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为移动应用生成高质量屏幕概念图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速产出移动端App的视觉稿或演示截图。
copy.tagline_en: Generate premium mobile app screen concepts and flows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce visual drafts or demo screenshots for mobile apps.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会把手机 App 界面画成干净的屏幕图，默认带手机边框，文字清晰易读，整套图风格统一。它只生成图片，不写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求给手机 App 画界面图或一整套屏幕流程时触发，例如 iOS、Android 或跨平台应用。技能会先选平台风格，再按流程生成多张屏幕图。

say.text: 给我画一个 iOS 健身 App 的首页和打卡流程
say.note: 会生成一组带手机边框的界面图，风格统一。

say.text: 设计一个 Android 银行 App 的登录页和主页
say.note: 按 Android 风格生成，带清晰的导航结构。

say.text: 画一套跨平台购物 App 的五个屏幕
say.note: 会保持同一设计系统，画面干净。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will render mobile app screens as clean device-framed images, with readable text and a consistent visual system across the set. It only generates images, never code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for mobile app screen images or a multi-screen flow, for iOS, Android, or cross-platform products. It picks a platform style first, then produces a coherent set.

say_en.text: Create an iOS fitness app home screen and check-in flow.
say_en.note: Generates a set of framed app screens with a unified look.

say_en.text: Design an Android banking app login page and home page.
say_en.note: Uses Android-style layout with clear navigation.

say_en.text: Draw a five-screen cross-platform shopping app set.
say_en.note: Keeps one design system across the screens.
